description: A valid token of alice in tenant beta\uD800 (an unpaired surrogate, which a Redis key writes as ?) is 401 token-invalid, evaluated as anonymous, where it would otherwise be authenticated in that tenant (and denied 403). This harness stores documents in memory, by Java string, so it cannot alias keys: that tenant beta\uD800 and tenant beta? would share a Redis key is guarded by cocache:UnpairedSurrogateKeyTest.
